assessment.match_notes: File:Glass-of-water.jpg is a well-known real photograph of a clear drinking glass about half filled with pure colorless water, shot by Derek Jensen (Tysto, own work, released as PD-self). Visually verified: colorless transparent liquid, clean neutral background, no watermark, sharp focus. It matches the task exactly: substance H2O, state liquid, display name 'nuoc' (water). The half-full glass clearly shows the liquid state and is an iconic, game-friendly representation of water.
